title: Ray S NDE 4282
content: I had been in an old 1957 Chevy on a cold day - I was playing with toys on the back seat. While sitting on the floor of the car close to the floor the carbon monoxide poison was coming in through the cracks in the floorboards. In the 1960s, it was common to leave a child in a car. As I said it was cold, my brother and sister went into a store to get ink for our dad - I stayed in the car playing while the car was left running. Thirty minutes or so later, my brother and sister returned for another fifteen or so minute drive home. I remember feeling real sleepy. When we pulled into the driveway my brother and sister just ran in the house as I tried to get my toys together and having a hard time thinking - I remember that I decided to just bring my Monopoly Game (because I liked the red houses). As I walked up the walkway I felt my energy drain from my body so I yelled out for my mother. Last thing I remember was seeing one of those little red houses falling to the ground from inside my body - then it all changed in reverse - I watched the little house fall from outside of my body and watched as my mother came to the porch and yelled for father my brother and sister crying. As for me? Just calm it was just after Christmas and I got the sheep skin coat that I bugged my parents for - I only bring this up because my brother bought me a purple slush while he was in the store earlier and I could see my dad trying to revive me and the slush staining my coat! So here I am dead and I am upset over a coat! Don't know how long this was all taking; I just know I was slowly rising higher floating in the tree looking down. Next thing I remember was waking up in the Union Hospital in Freetown, Massachusetts, with everyone around me asking if I was going to be okay now. I looked at my mother and said, 'Mom is my coat ruined now, will the purple come out?' It was at that point the room went 'dead' silent - you could have heard a pin drop because unknown to me my clothes had been remove at the scene and no one knew where they were? So how did I know, but only for the fact I was there viewing the actions from above. The first to speak was the doctor he asked me how and at what point did I know that I soiled my coat? I told him while I was floating in the tree looking down at my body and my dad. The doctor said it was very important that I speak to a special nurse who asked me all kinds of questions. When I asked her why so many questions she said it isn't everyday a boy dies and can come back to talk about it. She said it was because I had died and they wanted to know what it looked and felt like so they could keep a record of it.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reports watching events after collapsing, then “slowly rising higher floating in the tree looking down” at his body and his dad trying to revive him.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Carbon monoxide poisoning while left in a running car (exhaust entering through floorboard cracks).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He describes an out-of-body perspective (watching his body and father attempting revival) and then waking in the hospital.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with rising/floating to a tree looking down, then awakening back in the hospital; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports perceiving a Monopoly red house falling “from inside my body,” then seeing it “in reverse” from outside his body; he also reports floating “in the tree” while observing events below.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Last thing I remember was seeing one of those little red houses falling to the ground from inside my body - then it all changed in reverse - I watched the little house fall from outside of my body…”; “I was floating in the tree looking down at my body and my dad.”; “it isn't everyday a boy dies and can come back to talk about it.”
